# Anivora 0.1.41 — Native bug reports and Discord community integration

- Add **Report Bug** directly below **Support Anivora** in Profile. Guests can submit a native form without signing in; all existing controls and app features retain their behavior.
- Keep entered text on failures, prevent repeated submissions and show a report reference. Optional device diagnostics require consent. Reports may be public in the Discord bug forum; never include credentials.
- Verify submissions using a restricted Turnstile challenge and short-lived, payload-bound receipts. Cloudflare stores reports durably and delivers them to Discord independently of Render.
- Preserve historical channels while adding tracked bug/feature forums, moderated status tags, private support tickets, Community Onboarding and verified release announcements.
- Synchronize staff-approved reports with private GitHub Issues. A source fix becomes released only after explicit staff association with a verified official APK.
- Extend the owner dashboard with queue, synchronization and automation health while retaining existing analytics and authentication.

Android version code **43**, newer than 0.1.40/code 42. Package
`com.brandon300.anivora`; ARM64; Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. The established signing
certificate must pass verification before publication so this updates existing installations.

Discord remains optional. No Discord login, OAuth, account linking or identity sync
is added. Anivora Bot's existing name, avatar and managed Administrator role remain
unchanged. Native screenshot upload is not offered; screenshots can be attached in
Discord. Render's existing bandwidth suspension and billing configuration are unchanged.

Publication requires the established TypeScript, lint, app/backend/bridge tests,
Expo compatibility, Android integration/native tests, compiled-source and package/
signer/integrity checks. Physical Hot 50i/Chromecast QA remains pending.

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/2a09e463fa5b2999c488e5efc1f6378849fca58d
